rayfin.environment.description: Name of the Fabric environment to authenticate against. 'PROD' uses the built-in production Fabric cloud. Any other value requires 'rayfin.environmentConfig' to be set.
rayfin.environmentConfig.description: Auth configuration for a non-PROD Fabric environment. Required whenever 'rayfin.environment' is not 'PROD'. See the rayfin-ppe-config skill for the exact values to use.
rayfin.environmentConfig.clientId.descri: Entra ID first-party app client ID to use when signing in.
rayfin.environmentConfig.scope.descripti: OAuth scope for the Fabric API (e.g. 'https://<resource>/.default').
rayfin.environmentConfig.sessionProvider: VS Code authentication session provider ID. Use 'microsoft' for public Azure AD, or 'microsoft-sovereign-cloud' for non-public authorities (in which case configure 'microsoft-sovereign-cloud.environment' and 'microsoft-sovereign-cloud.customEnvironment' separately).
